verdict.reasons: The image fails the core technical evidence requirements specified in the editorial review. The candidate shows a single long black pipe with a white clamp, rather than the requested 'one closed ribbed compression union installed inline between two continuous black irrigation pipes.' Furthermore, the 'no open pipe end' constraint is violated as the pipe terminates in a clearly open, cut end on the right side of the frame. While the AFP product roll is present, readable, and properly spaced from the irrigation lines, these significant deviations from the mandated technical installation details constitute core defects.
